purpose: Teach: 熊野/小澤/杉田/菅原/豊島/志村/川原/清原

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「熊野神社にお参りに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wanted to go pray at Kumano Shrine.
lines.style: Gentle, informational. Soft opening. Warm eyes on Sho. Conversational pace with a slight pause before the shrine name, as if setting it up for him to hear. No urgency — just passing along something Dad said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小澤征爾のクラシック特番観たよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — I watched a Seiji Ozawa classical music special with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening attack. Clear and present — wanting her attention and her excitement. Quick pace, alive. The enthusiasm of a child who has something to share that he thinks is grown-up enough to matter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉田玄白の解体新書を解説しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to explain Sugita Genpaku's anatomy book to you.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery with a slight smile in the voice. Slower pace than the previous line — taking a breath before the detailed title. Genuinely pleased that Dad is thinking of Sho this way. Trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと菅原道真の天神様にお参り行ったよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — Dad and I went to pray at the Sugawara shrine! We saw the Tenjin statue.
lines.style: Eager, almost breathless opening. Speaking quickly because the memory is fresh and he wants to fit it all in. Small upward lift on the shrine name. Genuine and unselfconscious — just reporting what happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「豊島園、つまり昔の遊園地は懐かしい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Toshimaen — the old amusement park — brings back so many memories.
lines.style: Nostalgic tone. Slower, more reflective pace. Slight wistfulness in the voice without sadness. A small pause before the explanation, like she's giving Dad's memory room to land. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと志村けんの追悼番組観たよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — I watched a memorial program about Shimura Ken with Dad!
lines.style: Eager opening, but with a shade more gentleness than the other excited lines. Still bright and present, but aware of the memorial nature. Clear diction. The pride of sharing something meaningful, even if it's tinged with the solemnity of what it was about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが川原で石を集めて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad collects stones for you down by the riverbank.
lines.style: Quiet affection underneath. Simple, direct statement delivered with understated warmth. No fanfare — just noticing what Dad does. Slight pause before 'riverbank' to let the image settle. Soft, steady tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと清原和博の伝記映画観たよ
lines.en: Big sis Mei — Dad and I watched a documentary about Kazuhiro Kiyohara together!
lines.style: Warm, contented opening. Slightly slower than the other eager lines — less about breathless reporting, more about savoring the memory. Soft smile in the voice. The happiness of shared time with Dad, not just the event itself.
